Offensive · Academic lab

Web Application Penetration Testing

Documented eight XSS exercises and four SQL injection flags in a controlled ethical hacking environment.

Burp SuiteSQLmapXSSSQLi

Method: Input probing, intercepted HTTP requests, payload refinement, client-side context analysis and database enumeration.

Evidence: Reflected and DOM-based XSS, filter bypass testing, UNION-based SQL injection and vulnerable account-management logic. The report also documents unsuccessful tests.

Defensive takeaway: Contextual output encoding, parameterized queries, server-side authorization and secure input handling.

Academic controlled environment. Source report is available privately; screenshots should be redacted before publication.

503Agent-start rule

Captured lab evidence

Select an image to inspect it at full resolution.

Scope and findings. Agent registration and the agent-start alert are confirmed by the screenshots. The CIS scan reported 39 passing, 74 failing and 62 non-applicable checks (175 total).
